allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Implement training improvements for faster convergence

Priority 1: Batch Inference
- Refactor do_best_move\(\) to collect all candidate states first
- Make single batched prediction call instead of per-move calls
- Expected 50-100x speedup in move selection

Priority 2: TD Learning
- Add compute_td_targets\(\) for TD\(0\) with bootstrapped values
- Terminal states get actual reward, earlier states use gamma * -V\(s''\)
- Values negated for opponent perspective
- New flags: --use-td \(default\), --gamma 0.95

Priority 3: Exploration Schedule
- Add get_exploration_temp\(\) and get_epsilon\(\) with exponential decay
- Temperature decays from high exploration to low over training
- New flags: --initial-temp, --final-temp, --temp-decay
- New flags: --initial-epsilon, --final-epsilon, --epsilon-decay
- Add --benchmark flag for timing stats

Priority 4: Enhanced State Encoding
- Support 6-channel encoding with corner/center/turn awareness
- Ch 0-2: pieces \(unchanged\), Ch 3: corners, Ch 4: center, Ch 5: turn
- New flag: --enhanced-encoding \(default: legacy 3-channel\)

Priority 5: Batch Normalization
- Add BatchNorm layers after Conv2D in sonnet model
- Improves training stability
- New flag: --no-batchnorm to disable

Also: Update CLAUDE.md with strategy section and new training options

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
